title: Water and rise
description: Two measurements per observation, with color and form naming the group and italic notes on selected readings.

props.name: data
props.description: { id, label, group, x, y, note? } observations with unique nonempty IDs and a declared group. Null and non-finite coordinates are unavailable: they are counted below the plot, never drawn. An optional short note is written beside the point.

props.name: groups
props.description: One to four { id, label, tone? } groups with unique nonempty IDs. Each group has its own point form (circle, square, diamond, triangle) as well as a color; omitted tones follow the group order.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: Horizontal measurement name for the axis title and tooltips. Defaults to X.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: Vertical measurement name for the axis title and tooltips. Defaults to Y.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned chart heading. Defaults to Relationship.

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned context beside the heading.

props.name: xFormatter
props.description: Formats horizontal ticks and tooltips. Defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimal places.

props.name: yFormatter
props.description: Formats vertical ticks and tooltips. Defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimal places.

props.name: animate
props.description: Defaults to true; scoped finite motion honors live reduced-motion changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional container classes. The chart fills its parent; dense plots scroll locally.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible chart title. Arrow keys inspect observations through Recharts.
